description: Tracés des lignes de bus au format Shape is a dataset listed in IDELIS open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IDELIS. Liste et tracés des lignes de bus du réseau IDELIS dans l'agglomération paloise. Coverage: Pau agglomeration (Idelis network). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are tracés, lignes, bus, idelis, shapes. The portal shows 54 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-idelis-fr-portal.
